mapper.select: SELECT m.meeting_minute_id AS "meetingMinuteId", m.title, m.content AS "summary", TO_CHAR(m.meeting, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS "meetingDate", md.name AS "authorName" FROM meeting_minutes m JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = m.project_id LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL ) ORDER BY m.meeting DESC NULLS LAST, m.created DESC, m.meeting_minute_id DESC
